key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where to place the lyrics indicator in the top panel.

key.name: show-idle-text
key.description: Whether to show a custom message when no song is playing.

key.name: idle-text
key.description: Custom text to display when no song is playing. Leave empty for the default localized message.

key.name: show-no-lyrics-text
key.description: Whether to show a custom message when lyrics are not available.

key.name: no-lyrics-text
key.description: Custom text to display when lyrics are not available for the current song. Leave empty for the default localized message.
